verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe faceting as filters that also return distribution data, with aggregated counts for field values (e.g. "Color: Red (12), Blue (8)"). They explicitly cite e-commerce navigation by brand, color, size and price range with counts per option, backed by a facet-search endpoint and a React InstantSearch integration. The early community complaint about a single-filter limit comes from a 2020 thread and does not concretely contradict the current faceting docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that counts across multiple facets come back in one search response, detail on how range facets are handled (e.g. min/max stats), and independent hands-on corroboration of faceted navigation.
